selection.selection: Independent reference curator selects two natural alternating-conversation cases per 2/3-speaker stratum, requiring each participant to return in at least three annotated turns and contribute at least ten seconds of speech. This distinguishes sustained conversation from one-off incidental voices; all prior diagnostic/failure cases remain reported separately. Selection by SHA256(native362-holdout-v1/ID), full WAV 60–300 seconds from ZIP metadata. Previously exposed ten case count mappings excluded. Case counts and turn labels remain private until native and oracle predictions are frozen. No prediction results used for selection. All providers/defaults remain unchanged and unconstrained.

protocol: Official independently verified RTTM activity; label-permutation-invariant DER with 0/250 ms collars and overlap scored. Counts/turn labels held out from inference; no count bounds, alternate runs or tuning. All tentative outcomes remain scored. Native wall time includes the whole workflow; oracle wall time is diarization only, so these are not throughput comparisons.
